# Research interface — compatibility fixture vault

The vault every branch that touches `bin/lib_research.py`, `bin/lib_vault.py`, `bin/knowledge-reindex.py` or `bin/mnemon-search.py` must read the same way (docs/specs/2026-10-27-research-interface.md §11). `Sources/` holds six legacy revisions (one bookmark-tier with an extract, one bookmark-tier without any extract, one superseded pair, one captured without an extract); `Synthesis/` one stable and one seed note; `Collections/` one valid open dossier with every accepted line form, an annotated one (`...` closer, comments after lists and inside a block list, quoted scalars with comments, a decorated role), a minimal `inbox` one, a `closed` one with the veto fields and an item whose target file is missing, two open dossiers that veto (`wiki: off`; a name in `suppressed_pages`), and four documents that must fail: every rejected line form, a duplicate `## Items`, a broken frontmatter, a missing `## Items`. `Wiki/` (phase 3b) holds ten pages, one per derived state of the interface §9: a clean contradiction page with a verified heading locator and a verified quote locator (`Trust — four answers`), `stale` (rests on the superseded revision), `inputs-changed` (a dossier hash and a template version that moved), `edited-outside-update` (a wrong `body_sha256`, also over the goldens' word budget), `orphan` (a closed, an inbox and a missing dossier), `suppressed` twice (`wiki: off`; `suppressed_pages`), `unbound` twice (unlisted links, `kind ≠ inputs.kind`, `inputs.collections ⊄ collections`; a wrong observed seal, a missing heading, a quote not in the source, a link outside the instance, an unresolved link), a schema failure, and a dot-file the readers skip. The pages' prints are observations of the fixture files — `prints.py --check` verifies them, `prints.py` prints every fingerprint when a fixture changes on purpose; their `based_on` names only revisions the dossiers already file, so `doctor-data.json` stays byte for byte. The expected readings live next to it in `../expected/` and are compared by `tests/test_research.sh` (`tests/fixtures/research/generate.py --check`; `--write` regenerates them after a deliberate contract change, which is a spec change in the same PR).

Phase 3c (the research operations, `docs/research.md`) adds nothing here: `tests/test_research.py` (`ResearchOperationTests`) runs every operation on a temporary copy of this vault with a stub `claude` that answers from `../answers/*.json` — the canned answers of the fenced model (a clean contradiction page, a concept with one locator, the two Gamma revisions, and three hostile answers: a `[[Synthesis/…]]` link, a `## Log` heading inside a field, a locator into an unlisted revision). The pages the operations build never land in this vault.
